meta.dsopt_soaring: as the margin library: solve(mode=max_speed, cycle=travel, flat mode, tip_model=geometric, midpoints=True, rate_limits=True, rate_model=pb2v, n_min=0, profile_for(u10, log, roughness=coare35)), chi 20 deg first, the other chi only where that converged
meta.dsopt_motor: solve(mode=min_power, cycle=travel, motor=True, v_travel_min = 0.5 v_best_ld, same flat mode settings, profile_for(max(u10, 1)), ground effect off, seeds 0-2 then 3-5, maxiter 400) for every (aircraft, wind, chi) without a soaring cycle
meta.margin_order: standard first; light only where standard did not converge
meta.frame: wind toward +x, angles ccw from +x; z is the height above the surface; thrust in N per node (0 for soaring cycles)
meta.replay_filter: every entry replayed densely (mpc.replay_failures) against its own margins; failures marked missing: 0
meta.stamp_note: stamp re-computed after the replay filter and the later edits of mpc.py; the solves were run with the same dsopt.py

extension.cut: motor cycles at 3 and 6 m/s were not solved for the new courses (the slowest solves, about 170 to 300 s each) and no new course was solved at the calm; the planner then takes the new course from the nearest wind that has it (CycleLibrary.pick)
extension.calm: u10 = 0 entries are not solved: each is the cycle turned about the vertical onto its course (rotate_calm_entry); calm entries missing at the old courses and all the new courses are turned copies of the aircraft's lowest-power calm cycle
extension.soaring_to_motor: a soaring cycle that did not converge or made less than soaring_min_progress_m_s along its course is replaced by a motor cycle

upwind_motor.why: soaring cycles never fly upwind (every mean ground velocity has a downwind component), so the velocity hull needs motor cycles that do
